label: first copy step (input = orig token 0, output = orig token 1) in length-9 sequences
explanation: Fires only at the copy step right after <DEL> (t = L+1, recall_idx 1, prev_tok <DEL>), and almost only when L = 9 (99% of mass; a few at L = 8, none for L <= 7). It never fires in the original or delimiter phases. The position predicate catches ~97% of activations and ~99% of mass, but only ~2% of those steps fire, so whether it fires depends on token identity. Rate goes up when the input token (orig 0) is 3, b, y, d or 1, when the output token (orig 1) is h, b, 1, 3, m, p or z, and when there are more digits in the sequence. The largest activations are b->h and 3->x. Conjunctions with token lists raise precision to ~0.28 but lose about half the recall, so no compact token rule was found. Activations are very small (max 0.021).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=1 & in_tok=3 (+3.22), recall_idx=1 & in_tok=b (+2.62), phase=2 & out_tok=b (+2.06), next_out=h (+1.92), orig1=h (+1.79), phase=2 & out_tok=z (+1.76). Lower it: orig7=- (-2.93).
